title: GB system frequency at 15-second resolution (BMRS FREQ) as deviation from 50 Hz in mHz.
fetch_command: euroflex data gb fetch frequency  (or: .venv/bin/python scripts/research/gb_fetch_data.py --target frequency)

Excludes third-party rights that Elexon is not authorised to license.
attribution: Contains BMRS data © Elexon Limited copyright and database right 2023
transformation_notes: timestamp_utc = measurementTime (UTC, 15-second samples). Samples outside 48-52 Hz (telemetry zeros) are dropped (validation.invalid_samples_dropped_outside_48_52_hz).
frequency_dev_mhz = round((frequency_hz - 50) * 1000) as int16 (the source has three decimals, so this is lossless); frequency_hz = 50 + frequency_dev_mhz / 1000.
